criteria.true: This test asserts on internal implementation details of the unit under test rather than observable behavior: it reaches into private state, asserts exact internal call order, or breaks under a behavior-preserving refactor of the unit. Asserting on the STUBBED RETURN VALUES of an injected fake or mock is wiring the fake, not pinning - that is not a defect. The defect is only when the REAL unit's internals are pinned.
criteria.false: This test asserts on the public contract: given inputs, observable output or effects are checked, and a behavior-preserving rewrite of the unit's internals would keep the test green. Configuring fakes and asserting their recorded interactions to verify the contract is contract testing, not pinning.

criteria.true: A boolean here is named so that call sites read as a double negative or invite misreading: negated names (isNotX, disableX, noX), names whose polarity flips between declaration and use, or a flag whose name hides what true actually does.
criteria.false: Every boolean here has an affirmative name whose true-case is obvious at the call site (isEnabled, verbose, retry). A name is not confusing merely because the domain is subtle.
